aha: Two shafts sink below the road and need three stones but only shafts 1 and 3 have stones over their deep part; drop the far shaft-4 stone and escort it left along the road, past the live jellyfish in shaft 2, into the second slot of shaft 1, then run the pearl past the same jellyfish.
deadlocks: Pushing the pearl before both deep shafts are filled: it falls into the shaft.
Shoving a stone right toward the gate: it stops against the gate and blocks it.
Shoving a stone left past the filled shaft 1: it ends up against the pearl and can never move again.
